name: cooldown-lens
displayName: Cooldown Lens – npm Package Age & Minimum Release Age
description: See how old every npm dependency version is, right inside package.json. Flags versions still inside your supply-chain cooldown (npm min-release-age, pnpm minimumReleaseAge, Yarn npmMinimalAgeGate, Bun minimumReleaseAge) and suggests the newest safe version.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Cooldown Lens ignores registry URLs declared in project files and only talks to the registry configured in your user settings (default: registry.npmjs.org).

virtualWorkspaces.description: Cooldown configuration files are only discovered on the local file system.

cooldownLens.enabled.description: Enable Cooldown Lens for package.json files.

cooldownLens.defaultCooldownDays.description: Cooldown (in days) used when the project has no package-manager cooldown configuration (.npmrc min-release-age, pnpm minimumReleaseAge, bunfig.toml install.minimumReleaseAge, .yarnrc.yml npmMinimalAgeGate).

enumDescriptions: Read the cooldown from the project's package-manager configuration, falling back to cooldownLens.defaultCooldownDays.
Always use cooldownLens.defaultCooldownDays and ignore project configuration.
cooldownLens.thresholdSource.description: Where the cooldown threshold comes from.

cooldownLens.registry.markdownDescription: Registry base URL (for example `https://registry.npmjs.org/` or an internal mirror). Empty = auto-detect from the project's `.npmrc` / `.yarnrc.yml` / `bunfig.toml` (trusted workspaces only), otherwise `https://registry.npmjs.org/`. The registry must return the `time` field in package metadata.

cooldownLens.allowInsecureHosts.description: Hosts that may be contacted over plain http (e.g. a local Verdaccio). All other registries must use https.

cooldownLens.offline.description: Never contact the registry; only use cached metadata (useful on planes, air-gapped machines or when the registry is unreachable).

cooldownLens.cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long fetched registry metadata stays fresh before it is fetched again.

cooldownLens.maxConcurrentRequests.description: Maximum number of registry requests in flight at the same time.

cooldownLens.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for a single registry request.

cooldownLens.inlineAges.description: Show the release age as inline text after each dependency.

cooldownLens.codeLens.description: Show a summary CodeLens above each dependency section.

cooldownLens.diagnosticSeverity.description: Severity used for versions that are still inside the cooldown window.

cooldownLens.excludePackages.description: Extra package names or glob patterns (e.g. @myorg/*) that are exempt from the cooldown, in addition to excludes declared in package-manager config.

scripts.test:integration: node esbuild.mjs && node scripts/build-integration.mjs && node out/integration/runTest.js
